title: Warmly Crumbly Peruvian Tofu Tiradito
description: A tangy and crumbly Peruvian dish featuring silken tofu, perfect for a romantic evening, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is served in a kadhai vessel as a tiradito form.

ingredients.name: silken tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and saute for 1 minute.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and grapefruit juice.
Pour the juice mixture over the tofu and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast the bread cubes until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the tiradito, place a portion of the tofu mixture onto a plate, top with toasted bread cubes and serve immediately.
